surface_mechanism_description: The ALD copper nitride film was reduced to metallic copper by annealing at 200 °C or higher temperatures. The growth rate of ALD copper nitride was 0.1 nm/cycle at 120–140 °C on both ruthenium and silicon oxide substrates, and the thickness of the film was reduced approximately 20% by annealing.
